policy.notes: Add only measured vendor/community/local power observations with enough identity to avoid combining incompatible configurations. Internal-rail observations may be retained but are research-only for complete-device power estimation.

records.notes: Exact reviewed configuration: MacBook Pro 16 2021, M1 Max 32-core GPU, 64GB unified memory, 2TB SSD. Idle value is the review's average idle measurement; load is the review's average load measurement.

identity.model: msi geforce rtx 3090 gaming x trio

records.notes: Review reports gaming power around 350W for the MSI Gaming X Trio. This is graphics-card-only power and must not be treated as complete-node wall input.
